proposals.title: Write ADR-002, ADR-004, ADR-009 and register both open spec blockers
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance criteria state explicitly: ADR-009 must be written and the CanonicalEncoder implemented before any StateHash exists. ADR-002 specifies the hash function bit-by-bit before any rand() implementation. ADR-004 specifies rounding-mode enforcement before the division helper can be typed correctly. All three are DEFINIR items mandated as prerequisites by §15 and §19. In parallel, the transcendental-function contradiction (§5.1 requires log-space price arithmetic via Math.log/Math.exp; §13 prohibits both in all pure packages) and the tools/* dependency-edge gap (tools: [] in the boundary graph, yet tools/replay and tools/bench must import from application/domain) are unregistered specification conflicts that block their respective work fronts. Neither packages/world nor tools/* can acquire cross-workspace imports until these are in SPEC_BLOCKERS.md.

proposals.title: Implement packages/core: branded numerics, positional RNG, division helper, CanonicalEncoder
proposals.why_now: packages/core is the sole dependency of every other pure package. Without branded Money/Quantity/Price/Rate (bigint) and Tick (safe-integer number) types, ADR-003 and ADR-004 have no enforcement and violations accumulate from the first file written in any dependent package. Without rand() implementing ADR-002 bit-exactly, packages/world cannot begin. Without CanonicalEncoder implementing ADR-009, no StateHash can be computed and INV-01, INV-22, and every hash-dependent invariant have no foundation. This is the first implementation step after the ADRs are accepted.

proposals.title: Implement packages/world (2-octave price generator), packages/domain (ledger + spot orders), packages/application (canonical tick loop and save)
proposals.why_now: These three packages compose the functional core required by FASE-1. The 2-octave positional price generator in packages/world delivers INV-02. The double-entry multi-commodity ledger in packages/domain delivers INV-04 through INV-07. The canonical 10-step tick loop in packages/application (§7, TRAVADO sequence) is listed explicitly in FASE-1 acceptance criteria, and it is the only layer that legally composes world and domain. The save structure per ADR-006 enables tools/replay. None of these invariants are independently verifiable — they become testable only when composed through application. This work requires the transcendental-function blocker (BLOCKER-0001 from IDEA-001) to be resolved via ADR before packages/world implements the price generator, because §13 prohibits Math.log/Math.exp in pure packages and packages/world is pure.

proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance criteria explicitly require: simulation running in a dedicated worker outside the render thread with a typed message contract. INV-29 requires contextIsolation active, nodeIntegration off, and sandbox active, verified by CI. The minimal interface (chart, balance, buy/sell, pause/1x controls) is also a stated FASE-1 deliverable. A minimal installer stub requires a working Electron main to exist. Deferring this to later phases means discovering ABI, module-native, and process-boundary problems after the domain simulation is already built and harder to restructure.

proposals.title: Implement tools/replay (divergence reporter) and tools/bench (calibration baseline)
proposals.why_now: Both tools/replay and tools/bench are explicit FASE-1 acceptance criteria. tools/replay must replay two save files and report the first tick where StateHash diverges — this is the primary regression instrument for INV-01. tools/bench must establish the calibration micro-benchmark, the reference ratios against which all performance lines are measured, and freeze them in a versioned file; without frozen ratios the performance budget from §18 has no enforcement mechanism. The tools/* dependency edge gap (BLOCKER-0002 from IDEA-001) must be resolved before either tool can import from packages/application.

repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: Zero ADRs written. FASE-1 acceptance criteria explicitly require ADR-009 to be written and the CanonicalEncoder implemented before any StateHash exists. ADR-002 and ADR-004 are prerequisites for packages/core. Additionally, two spec contradictions remain unregistered in SPEC_BLOCKERS.md: the transcendental-function conflict (§5.1 vs §13) and the tools/* dependency-edge gap (§14.5 defines no allowed outbound edges for tools, yet tools/replay and tools/bench must import from other packages to fulfil their FASE-1 mandate).

warnings: SPEC CONTRADICTION (unregistered) — §5.1 constructs prices in log-space requiring Math.log and Math.exp; §13 prohibits Math.log and Math.exp in all pure packages (packages/world is pure). This conflict has been identified since CYCLE-000024 but is still absent from SPEC_BLOCKERS.md. It must be registered per §19 before any packages/world implementation proceeds. An ADR specifying a fixed-point or lookup-table implementation with bit-identical cross-platform results is required to close it.

DEFINIR GAP (unregistered) — §14.5 defines directed edges only for packages/ and apps/. tools/* is mapped to DIRECT_EDGES.tools = [] in the committed boundary graph, meaning tools/replay and tools/bench currently have no allowed outbound imports. Both tools must import from packages/application to fulfil their FASE-1 acceptance criteria. The allowed edges for tools/* must be registered in SPEC_BLOCKERS.md and resolved via ADR or provisional decision before those tools acquire any cross-workspace imports.

DEFINIR ITEMS not yet addressed — ADR-002 (hash function), ADR-004 (rounding-mode enforcement mechanism), and ADR-009 (CanonicalEncoder) are all explicitly required before their corresponding implementations. §15 FASE-1 states: 'ADR-009 escrito e o encoder implementado antes de qualquer hash de estado existir.' None of the three ADR files exist in docs/decisions/.

OCTAVE PARAMETERS unresolved — the number of octaves, periods, and amplitudes for trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise are DEFINIR per §5.1 and must be fixed in a versioned configuration file with an ADR before packages/world implements the price generator. Post-implementation changes require an encodingVersion bump and invalidate all frozen reference StateHashes.

BENCHMARK VELOCITY — 25 ideation cycles have elapsed. TASK-0002 (npm workspaces bootstrap) was the first accepted production commit. All packages remain empty stubs. FASE-1 requires packages/core, packages/world, packages/domain, packages/application, a minimal Electron UI, tools/replay, tools/bench, and a working installer. The ADR prerequisite gate (IDEA-001) is the immediate critical path blocker.
